infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AURA uses your location to keep your journey on route and to alert your trusted contact if something goes wrong.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AURA keeps monitoring your journey in the background so a deviation or a long stop is noticed even when the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AURA uses the camera to describe obstacles and signage ahead of you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AURA lets you answer a safety check by voice.
